name: wait_until_status_clear
description: Calls a helper in a loop and re-reads two status bytes from the same record after each pass, returning the combined byte once its high bit is clear.

name: invoke_handler_twice
description: Calls the same helper twice in a row and returns, with no other logic, so it is a fixed two-step sequence.

name: process_object_pending_actions
description: Checks the flag bits of an object record in turn. For each set bit it writes a command code and a stored coordinate into a shared parameter block and calls a helper, clearing the bit afterwards. Some paths also set status bits or check a counter before dispatching.

name: run_seven_fixed_steps
description: Calls the same helper seven times in succession and returns, so it runs a fixed batch of seven sub-steps with no branching.

name: flag_and_dispatch_pending_move
description: Sets a status bit on an object record. If a second bit is also set, it sends a command with the object's stored coordinate through two helpers and then clears that second bit.

name: emit_indexed_table_batches
description: When two object fields are set it clears one pending flag, then picks a record from a fixed pointer table using a computed index. It runs a countdown over the record's count word, calling a helper four times per pass.

name: clear_flags_and_run_steps
description: Calls two helpers, then when either of two per-object flag bytes has bit 0 set it clears those bits and calls five helper steps in order.

name: repeat_helper_up_to_six
description: Clamps a non-negative counter to at most six and calls a helper once for each remaining count, counting down to zero. A negative input causes no calls.

name: clamp_value_to_minimum
description: Raises one field of an object record to the value of a second field whenever it is below it, so the first never drops under the second.

name: send_object_position_command
description: Copies a 16-bit coordinate from an object record into the shared command block, sets the command code to two and invokes the transfer helper.

name: check_and_run_stage_loop
description: Checks a state word and two object-state tests. When they pass, it runs a stage loop that counts a stage variable from one up to eleven, resetting timers and buffers and calling helpers for each stage, and waits on a sync flag inside each stage.

name: check_and_run_stage_loop
description: Checks a state word and two object-state tests. When they pass, it runs a stage loop that counts a stage variable from one up to eleven, resetting timers and buffers and calling helpers for each stage, and waits on a sync flag inside each stage.

name: check_and_run_stage_loop
description: Checks a state word and two object-state tests. When they pass, it runs a stage loop that counts a stage variable from one up to eleven, resetting timers and buffers and calling helpers for each stage, and waits on a sync flag inside each stage.

name: check_and_run_stage_loop
description: Shared entry to the stage-loop routine, called from several places. It checks a state word and two object-state tests, then runs the stage loop that counts a stage variable from one up to eleven with helper calls per stage.

name: finish_object_action_state
description: Decrements a pending-count word, sets low-order status bits in two flag bytes of the shared block, clears the object's long-word field, sets its state field to four and decrements its remaining-steps counter.

name: mark_object_action_done
description: Sets low-order status bits in two flag bytes of the shared block, clears the object's long-word field, sets its state field to four and decrements its remaining-steps counter. It is the same as the routine above without the pending-count decrement.

name: select_next_stream_byte
description: Returns one byte from a three-slot buffer, using a repeat counter to choose the slot. It returns the first slot when the counter is zero, the second while the decremented counter stays nonzero, and the third when it reaches zero.

name: advance_seed_or_read_byte
description: If a flag is set, advances a 32-bit seed with a shift-and-feedback step and, when the low nibble is zero, steps it twice more; it then sets or clears bits in a control byte from the low bits and two thresholds. Otherwise it returns the next byte from the counted three-slot buffer, like the routine above.

name: read_first_stream_byte
description: Returns the byte in the first slot of the three-slot stream buffer without changing any counter.

name: read_third_stream_byte
description: Returns the byte in the third slot of the three-slot stream buffer without changing any counter.

name: advance_seed_and_toggle_bit
description: Advances a 32-bit seed with a shift-and-feedback step. When its low nibble is zero it steps twice more, toggles one bit of a control byte chosen from the low seed bits, clears bits by thresholds on two counters, and stores the control byte back.

name: select_next_stream_byte
description: Returns one byte from a three-slot buffer, using a second repeat counter. It returns the first slot when the counter is zero, the second while the decremented counter stays nonzero, and the third when it reaches zero.

name: update_seed_control_bits
description: If a flag is set, advances the seed, sets bit 7 of a control byte, clears bit 6 when a per-object field is large, and sets bit 6 when the low nine seed bits are zero. Otherwise it returns the next byte from the counted three-slot buffer.

name: read_first_stream_byte
description: Returns the byte in the first slot of the three-slot stream buffer without changing any counter.

name: read_third_stream_byte
description: Returns the byte in the third slot of the three-slot stream buffer without changing any counter.

name: update_seed_control_flags
description: Advances the 32-bit seed in two steps, sets bit 7 of a control byte, clears bit 6 when a per-object field exceeds eight, toggles one bit chosen from the seed, and sets bit 6 when the low nine seed bits are zero.

name: initialise_object_record
description: Zeroes the timing, motion and state fields of an object record, stores the two incoming position arguments and a third word, and sets defaults including a status mask and a speed of 200. When a type field is clear and another field is not two, it also zeroes a count and sets a limit of ten.

name: accumulate_position_with_threshold
description: Adds a value returned by a helper to the object's 16-bit position field and sets a flag bit. When the position passes 500 while a counter is zero, it sets a second flag, increments the state field and decrements the counter.

name: clear_long_word_block
description: Clears a block of memory by writing zero to 16384 consecutive long words starting at a fixed base address.

name: wait_for_cia_port_clear
description: Spins until a bit of the global status byte is clear. That byte mirrors the CIA port A register, which carries the fire button and disk status bits.

name: toggle_state_word_on_timer
description: When a counter field has reached twenty-five, resets it to zero and inverts a 16-bit state word. Otherwise it clears that state word to zero.

name: tick_countdown_and_reload
description: When an enable word is nonzero, decrements a countdown word and, on reaching zero, reloads it from a stored reload value.

name: run_sequenced_update_steps
description: Calls a series of helpers in order. A status word selects one of two helper calls, a 32-bit counter is incremented when a flag is set, and when a second status word is zero it decrements a countdown and makes further helper calls.

name: call_and_decrement_zero_counter
description: When a 16-bit counter word is zero, calls a helper and a second routine and then decrements the counter word.

name: clear_counter_and_call_helper
description: When a 16-bit counter word is nonzero, sets it to zero, then calls a routine and a helper.

name: iterate_triple_word_table
description: Writes a constant to a fixed memory-mapped register, then walks a table of three-word entries, calling a helper for each entry until an entry with a negative first word ends the list.

name: iterate_triple_word_table
description: Writes a different constant to the same memory-mapped register, then walks the same kind of three-word entry table, calling a helper for each entry until a negative first word ends the list.

name: clear_bit2_in_six_entries
description: Clears bit 2 of six separate control bytes in a table whose entries are six bytes apart, at fixed addresses.

name: set_bit2_for_two_slots
description: Computes two entries of a six-byte-stride control table from two index words and sets bit 2 in each of them.

name: walk_table_after_optional_step
description: Calls a helper, calls a second helper when a status bit is set, writes a constant to a memory-mapped register, then walks a three-word entry table calling a helper for each entry until a negative first word.

name: walk_table_with_flag_base
description: Selects one of two three-word entry tables by testing a flag bit, writes a constant to a memory-mapped register, then calls a helper for each entry until an entry with a negative first word ends the walk.

name: iterate_triple_word_table
description: Writes a constant to the memory-mapped register and walks a three-word entry table, calling a helper for each entry until a negative first word ends the list.

name: step_position_and_rotate_buffers
description: Moves two 16-bit position words by a fixed step of 416, reversing direction at the edges, and alternates between two buffer areas. It zeroes the link pointer fields of the chosen buffer, calls a helper, stores a byte from a global, and increments it when a counter is nonzero.

name: store_buffer_pointer_plus_four
description: Calls a helper and two routines, then stores the current buffer pointer plus four into a global. Its facts show the copper channel two location register is touched, so the stored value feeds that register.

name: copy_table_and_build_pointers
description: Clears a field, copies 150 words from a global table into a buffer, and writes five pointer entries that step through the buffer in 276-byte strides. It then loops, filling line entries from a source word and a per-line counter until a stop word is set.

name: copy_table_and_build_pointers
description: Same copy-and-pointer logic as the neighbouring routine, but the 150-word table is copied into the object record block rather than a fixed buffer.

name: write_custom_register_pairs
description: Clears a state word, then walks a table of register-value pairs, writing each value to the custom chip register at its listed offset from the chip base until an end marker. It finishes by zeroing 1280 long words at a fixed buffer.

name: copy_sixteen_longs_to_record
description: Copies sixteen long words from the source block addressed by the address register into two fixed eight-long slots of the record. Eleven callers use it.

name: initialise_state_and_prime
description: Sets a group of state words to zero or fixed starting values, fills twelve long words with minus one, then calls a helper 832 times and once more to finish.

name: advance_counters_and_scan_table
description: When a state word is zero, increments several counters, toggles a flag word and conditionally bumps two more counters, and calls a routine when a countdown's low five bits clear. It then scans a twelve-entry table, calling a routine for each nonnegative entry, and copies a counter into a status word.

name: push_ring_buffer_entry
description: Decrements a delay counter and, when it goes negative, reads the next word from a stream, otherwise using a sentinel. It writes that word and a value derived from 336 minus a field into the next slot of a small ring buffer of 4-byte slots.

name: copy_source_rows_into_planes
description: When a 16-unit timer reaches sixteen, consumes a source index byte and copies eight rows of 64 words from a table-selected source into a multi-plane buffer, writing up to four planes spaced in the buffer. The column offset wraps after four steps.

name: copy_source_rows_into_planes
description: Same column-copy logic as the neighbouring routine, entered directly by address without the leading helper call.

name: copy_strip_rows_from_stream
description: Advances a timer by sixteen units and, on each step, picks a source row index from a stream (or from a countdown override). It then copies a strip of ninety-six words into buffer columns, writing four planes for the first four column steps and three planes afterwards.

name: copy_strip_rows_from_table
description: Copies a strip of ninety-six words per plane from the table entry chosen by the index argument into the buffer. It writes four planes when the column argument is below four and three planes otherwise.

name: set_mask_and_row_pointers
description: Computes a shift mask from the first argument and stores it, then fills four long-word row pointers, each 160 bytes further on, starting from an address derived from the second argument.

name: clear_four_plane_rows
description: Calls a helper in a loop until it returns zero, then zeroes fifteen rows of four bitplanes. Each row is 40 bytes further on and the planes are spaced 8000 bytes apart.

name: shift_words_right_five
description: Right-shifts each of fifty-nine words at a buffer pointer held in a global block by five bits.

name: copy_table_into_four_planes
description: Looks up a pointer from a table using an index argument plus 180, then copies fifteen groups of four words from that entry into four bitplanes spaced 8000 bytes apart, advancing 40 bytes per group.

name: emit_indexed_table_batches
description: Looks up a table entry from an index argument with a high-bit mask. If the entry's first word is one it runs one countdown, otherwise another, calling a helper four times per pass.

name: blit_rotated_masked_line
description: Rotates an inverted source long word by a shift count and merges it with two mask words into a destination long-word pair. When a flag is zero it also merges a rotated non-inverted second source into the pair.

name: blit_rotated_masked_word
description: Rotates an inverted source word by a shift count and ANDs it with a destination word. When a flag is zero it also ORs in a rotated second source word.

name: run_timed_step_loop
description: When a state word is zero, calls helpers and writes a fixed command when a flag is set. It then decrements two counters from their step values, calling helpers on each pass until both reach zero, and returns the last status word.

name: copy_entry_into_four_planes
description: Calls a helper, then copies fifteen groups of four words from a table entry held in a global block into four bitplanes spaced 8000 bytes apart, starting at a fixed offset and advancing 40 bytes per group.

name: store_value_and_call_six
description: Stores its argument in a global and then calls six helper routines in sequence, returning the global.

name: reconfigure_interrupts_and_dma
description: Reads the interrupt and DMA status registers, clears one audio and disk control bit, clears the interrupt enable master bit, then sets the DMA control register with its enable bit and a set of channel bits.

name: pulse_port_bit_then_delay
description: Clears bit 7 of a global CIA port image, runs a fixed countdown of one hundred iterations that clears bit 3 on each pass, then calls one further routine.

name: delay_then_wait_port_bit
description: Runs a fixed countdown of three thousand iterations, then spins until bit 5 of a global variable that holds the CIA port A status is clear.

name: wait_while_port_bit_set
description: While bit 4 of a global status byte is set, sets the low two bits to three and calls one further routine, touching the CIA port A and port B registers.

name: spin_on_status_then_skip
description: Spins while bit 4 of a global status byte is set. The loop that follows starts its counter at zero, so its body never runs.

name: poll_intreq_with_timeout
description: Clears a status bit, programs a DMA control value and two register words, then polls the interrupt request register for bit one for up to 200000 iterations. It sets a result word to two when the bit appears and repeats after a timeout.

name: clear_and_set_register_pair
description: Clears one custom register word and writes sixteen to a second register word, both at fixed offsets from the register base.

name: wait_for_status_bit_set
description: Spins until bit 4 of a global status byte is set. The byte mirrors the CIA B interrupt control status.

name: latch_status_into_four_words
description: Clears bit 3 of a global status byte, sets bit 7, and writes the result ORed with the top bit into four 16-bit slots of the local frame.

name: search_bitstream_for_marker
description: Scans a memory block bit by bit for a fixed sixteen-bit marker. If the marker is found, it sets a result flag to zero when the bit position is within a limit of 6700, otherwise to one. If the marker is not found, it sets the flag to one.

name: install_vblank_handler_and_enable
description: Stores a handler address in the level three interrupt vector, clears all interrupt enable bits, then enables the vertical blank interrupt together with the master bit.

name: vblank_interrupt_handler
description: Acknowledges the vertical blank interrupt request and updates a pending counter. When the counter is odd it sets a flag word to all ones, calls a stored callback through a pointer, reloads the counter from a stored value, and keeps a timer word at zero or above a level derived from a global.

name: decode_joystick_direction
description: Combines two bit pairs of a joystick port value into an index into a lookup table, then sets the top bit of the result when bit 7 of the port value is clear.

name: decode_direction_for_bit_index
description: Looks up a direction code from a lookup table using two bit pairs of an input word, and sets the top bit of the stored result when the bit selected by an index argument is clear in the port value.

name: update_direction_key_state
description: Decodes a raw keyboard code and its release bit. Cursor key codes set or clear the matching direction bits in a state byte, codes at or above sixty set or clear the top two bits except one ignored code, and all other codes are ignored.

name: repeat_helper_count_times
description: Calls a helper once for each unit of a 16-bit count argument, counting down until zero. A zero count makes no calls.

name: spin_until_status_changes
description: Loops on a status word compared with itself, so the listing has no exit condition. It is a wait-for-change spin on a word that other hardware or code updates.

name: clear_status_and_set_flag
description: Calls a helper, then when a status word equals sixty-nine it clears the status word and sets a flag word to one.

name: fetch_pending_table_byte
description: If a status word is nonzero with its top bit clear, reads a byte from a global table at that index. When the byte is not sixty-three it clears the status word and returns the byte, otherwise it returns zero.

name: sample_cia_bit_into_status
description: Clears bit 6 of a CIA control byte. When bit 3 of a second CIA byte is set, it sets bit 6 again and stores a bit-rotated, inverted copy of a global byte in a status word.

name: setup_sample_channel_record
description: When a flag word is zero, stores the level and mode words of one of four channel records, looks up a start address and a length from a table indexed by an argument, and sets the record's word count and a default value of ten thousand.

name: init_four_channel_records
description: Clears audio control words, then initialises four channel records with bit masks one, two, four and eight. Each record is pointed at a custom chip register block sixteen bytes after the previous one.

name: step_channel_playback_record
description: Calls three helpers, then while a channel counter is non-negative it writes a value into the channel record and counts the counter down. On reaching zero it loads the next address and length. Otherwise it writes the current value with its top bit set to a custom register, and it stores a table entry in the record.

name: step_channel_record_with_dma
description: Steps a channel record in the same way as its neighbour, but writes the top-bit-set value through the register base argument at the DMA control register offset.

name: select_indexed_table_entry
description: When the requested index differs from the last one, records it, writes a fixed value to the CIA B port image and calls three helpers. For any index other than twelve it loads a buffer pointer and three long words from a table indexed by the value.

name: poll_port_bit_then_restore
description: Writes a fixed value to a CIA port image. While bit 4 of that image is set it sets bit 0 and calls a helper, then sets bit 2 and clears it again when bit 0 is clear.

name: step_port_state_toward_target
description: Computes the signed difference between a requested value and the current port image. While the difference is nonzero it sets the direction bit, pulses bit 0 and calls a helper until it reports one. Then it sets bit 2, clears it again when bit 0 is clear, and returns zero.

name: strobe_port_bit_two
description: Sets bit 2 of a global port image and restores the saved image when bit 0 of the new value is clear.

name: run_dma_until_done
description: Writes a fixed value to the CIA port image, sets the top bit of a DMA control word, then loops calling helpers until one returns zero. It finishes by writing a clearing value to the DMA control register.

name: delay_fixed_countdown
description: Runs a countdown of four thousand ninety-six iterations with no other work.

name: read_disk_track_with_sync
description: Sets up a disk read by storing the MFM disk sync word, writing the disk length register twice, and waiting for the disk block-done interrupt request bit before clearing the length register. It repeats while an argument is nonzero.

name: write_port_image_after_calls
description: Calls two helpers, writes a fixed value to the CIA B port image, then calls one more helper.

name: wait_while_status_bit_five
description: Spins while bit 5 of a global CIA port A status byte is set.

name: decode_mfm_sector_block
description: If either of two fixed addresses holds the MFM sync pattern, decodes 1408 long words into a destination buffer by recombining alternating odd and even bits, then decodes two trailing long words into globals. Otherwise it returns without decoding.

name: stub_bad_instruction_data
description: Contains only an invalid instruction, so the decompiler truncates control flow here. It is bad data, not a working routine.

name: toggle_port_clock_bit
description: Sets bit 2 of a global port image and toggles bit 0. When bit 0 was previously clear, it adds two to the image, writes the saved high bits with bit 0 set, and calls a helper.

name: write_status_pair_and_call
description: Writes two fixed status values into a two-word parameter block, then calls a helper twice.

name: dispatch_or_clear_pending_slots
description: Looks up one character from a global table using the argument. If three pending-slot words are all negative it calls four stored routines; otherwise it sets each nonnegative pending word to minus one and calls a helper.

name: high_nibble_to_char
description: Returns the high four bits of a byte offset by the character code for zero, so values above nine do not become letters.

name: repeat_helper_until_zero
description: Calls a helper repeatedly while a 16-bit register value remains nonzero, relying on the helper to update it.

name: write_decimal_digits_backward
description: Writes the decimal digits of a number into a buffer from the end backwards, each as a digit character, dividing by ten until the remaining quotient is zero.

name: print_high_bit_terminated_string
description: Clears a status word, then calls a helper for each byte of a text string, stopping at a byte with its top bit set, and returns that terminating byte.

name: queue_byte_with_countdown
description: Takes a byte argument. While a countdown is pending it records the byte in one of two status words and counts down. Two particular byte values are ignored and a zero byte starts a two-step countdown. Any other byte triggers the slot dispatch: four stored routines run when all three slot words are negative, otherwise nonnegative slots are reset and a helper is called.

name: dispatch_or_clear_pending_slots
description: Same slot dispatch as the neighbouring routine, without the character lookup: four stored routines run when all three pending words are negative, otherwise nonnegative words are reset and a helper is called.

name: call_four_stored_routines
description: Calls four routine pointers held in the global block, in order, with no other work.

name: build_three_bit_lookup_entries
description: Takes three byte arguments, shifts each left by four and, over four passes, combines their carry bits into a three-bit index. Each pass stores the four-byte entry selected by that index from a fixed table into consecutive slots.

name: clear_eight_strided_bytes
description: Writes zero to eight bytes spaced by a stride argument, starting at a base address.

name: copy_eight_strided_bytes
description: Copies eight consecutive source bytes into destination bytes spaced by a stride argument, starting at a base address.

name: store_byte_at_offset
description: Writes one byte from a source pointer into the destination at an offset from the base address.

name: store_inverted_eight_strided
description: Writes the bitwise complement of eight consecutive source bytes into destination bytes spaced by a stride argument.

name: store_inverted_eight_strided
description: Same as its neighbour, reading the eight source bytes from a different source pointer.

name: fill_eight_strided_bytes_ones
description: Writes 255 to eight bytes spaced by a stride argument, starting at a base address.

name: convert_bytes_to_two_planes
description: Walks 64 groups of eight source bytes from the global block. For each byte it writes two output bytes into two fixed tables, combining the byte with the shifted copy of the previous byte to build a masked pair.

name: reset_copper_lists_and_buffer
description: Sets a status word to minus one, writes a DMA control value, loads two copper list addresses into the copper location registers and strobes the second copper jump register. It then zeroes eight thousand long words of a buffer.

name: zero_fixed_long_buffer
description: Zeroes eight thousand consecutive long words starting at a fixed buffer address.

name: fill_thirty_two_words
description: Writes a 16-bit argument into thirty-two consecutive words of a block at a fixed offset from the base.

name: invert_thirty_two_words
description: Flips the low twelve bits of thirty-two consecutive words in a block by exclusive-ORing each one with 4095. The routine is unreached in the listing.

name: set_step_from_sign
description: Stores its argument in a pending step word, then sets a companion word to zero when the argument is nonnegative or to 256 when it is negative.

name: advance_companion_word_step
description: When a pending step word is nonzero, adds it to a companion word. Once the companion's low byte is nonzero it clears the pending step and resets the companion to 256 for a positive step or to zero for a negative one.

name: blend_word_tables_by_weight
description: Writes 32 words of output, four bytes apart. When the weight word is zero it copies the first table, when it is 256 it copies the second, and otherwise it blends the three 4-bit fields of each pair of entries in proportion to the weight and its complement.

name: set_slots_from_cycle_table
description: Picks a value from a four-entry table using the low two bits of a counter, then writes that value to four slots spaced eight bytes apart.

name: set_bit_then_wait_global
description: Sets one bit, chosen by the low three bits of an argument, in a byte at an offset from the base, then spins until a global word equals minus one.

name: allocate_node_from_pool
description: If a free-count word is nonzero, decrements it, unlinks a node from the pending list and relinks it into one of two lists chosen by a selector argument. It stores a value in the node and returns a pointer to its data.

name: select_node_if_idle
description: Calls a helper, saves a register value in a global, and when the linked record's count word is zero stores that record as the selected node.

name: select_argument_node_if_idle
description: Saves a register value in a global, and when the argument record's count word is zero stores that record as the selected node.

name: advance_to_next_idle_node
description: Stores a saved register value into the link of the current node, then advances the current-node pointer to the following node when that node's count word is zero.

name: move_node_to_pending_list
description: Increments a counter, moves the current node from its list to the head of the pending list, and selects the node when its count word is zero.

name: initialise_node_pool
description: Initialises two empty list heads and a pending list head, then links sixty-four nodes spaced 314 bytes apart from a fixed region into the pending list and sets the free-count word to 64.

name: wait_until_counter_reaches
description: Calls a helper repeatedly until a counter word is no longer below the 16-bit argument.

name: check_flag_and_return
description: Reads a flag word and returns without effect in either case, so it does nothing observable.

name: stub_empty_return
description: Returns immediately without doing anything, so it is an empty routine.

name: create_object_record_from_template
description: Calls an allocator and, when it returns a record, copies five long words of a template into it, zeroes the following fields, sets default word values including a count of twenty-five, stores two callback pointers and three fixed addresses, and sets two byte fields.

name: create_object_record_from_template
description: Same record construction as its neighbouring routine, reached through a different entry point.

name: call_record_handler_when_idle
description: Calls an empty stub first. When the record's count word is zero, it calls a helper if a second word is also zero, then calls the handler pointer stored in the argument block.

name: create_object_record_from_template
description: Same record construction as the other routines of this name, reached from a different caller.

name: release_node_to_pending_list
description: Calls four helpers, then increments a counter and moves the current node to the head of the pending list, selecting the node when its count word is zero.

name: link_records_on_nonzero
description: Calls a helper and, when its test is not equal, stores each of two records in the other record's link field.

name: unlink_record_from_owner_slots
description: If the record's owner link is set, clears that link and clears any of the owner's four slot fields that point to this record.

name: unlink_record_from_owner_slots
description: Same unlink pattern as its neighbour, using the owner link field at a different offset.

name: unlink_record_from_owner_slots
description: Same unlink pattern as the neighbouring routines, using another owner link field.

name: unlink_record_from_owner_slots
description: Same unlink pattern as the neighbouring routines, using the owner link field at the first slot.

name: repeat_helper_by_count_down
description: Calls a helper in a loop and decrements a 16-bit count after each call. The test follows the decrement, so a zero argument runs the helper 65536 times.

name: call_helper_once
description: Calls one helper and returns, with no other logic.

name: call_helper_once
description: Same single helper call as the neighbouring stub.

name: run_three_steps_forever
description: Calls three helpers in an endless loop with no exit.

name: increment_packed_decimal_field
description: When a record's count word is nonnegative, sets a flag bit, increments a word counter, and adds one to a two-byte packed-decimal field with decimal carry from the last byte into the previous one.

name: dispatch_timed_table_entries
description: Either moves the current node to the pending list when a flag is set, or walks a table of entries from the last index, each with a signed first word. Nonnegative entries store their second word and call one of two helpers depending on a comparison between a timing word and the record's counter, repeating while the flag stays clear.

name: step_timed_table_entries
description: Reads the next entry of a timed table. Negative entries wait for a flag, while nonnegative entries store their value and compare the timing word with the record's counter, calling one of two helpers depending on the result.

name: step_timed_table_entries
description: Same timed-table walker as its neighbour. On an exact timing match it calls a helper and then moves on to the next entry, and it calls a second helper for other entries.

name: step_timed_table_entries
description: Waits for the flag, reloads the table pointer from the last index, then walks timed entries as its neighbours do, calling a helper for each step.

name: release_node_after_eleven_steps
description: Calls eleven helpers, then increments a counter and moves the current node to the pending list, selecting the node when its count word is zero.

name: setup_sample_channel_randomized
description: Advances a seed twice. When a flag word is zero it sets a position word from an object field, the seed's low five bits and a constant of 320, sets a length word to 64, and stores a start address and word count from a table, using a default value of ten thousand.

name: set_record_flag_after_call
description: Calls a helper, then sets the word at offset four of the argument record to one.

name: tick_schedule_and_trigger
description: When two status words are zero and a countdown reaches zero, reloads the countdown from a stored value that grows by eight while below 104, sets a flag word to minus one, and calls two helpers in each of two passes.

name: setup_sample_channel_indexed
description: Negates a toggle word and calls a helper, then chooses one of two channel records by the sign of the toggle. When a flag word is zero it sets a position word from the seed's low five bits, a length of 64, and a start address and word count from a table, using a default value of ten thousand.

name: setup_sample_channel_offset
description: Adds two to the index argument when a toggle word is nonnegative, steps a seed, and when a flag word is zero sets the channel record's position from the seed's low five bits, a length of 64, and a start address and word count from a table, using a default of ten thousand.

name: clip_and_blit_table_entry
description: Checks two status words, then either inserts a record into a list sorted by its key when its coordinates pass a range check and a budget counter allows, or looks up an entry by index, clips it against limits and, when a counter allows, programs the blitter pointer, modulo and size registers for it.

name: clip_and_blit_table_entry
description: Clips a table entry against the same limits as its neighbour and, when a budget counter allows, programs the blitter pointer, modulo and size registers. It takes the index from the argument register and has no list-insertion branch.

name: reset_list_and_counter
description: Calls a helper for each linked record until a link is null, then clears the list head, stores the head address in a global and sets a counter to 63.

name: reset_list_and_counter
description: Same reset as its neighbour, looping on the first word of the list head rather than on the next link.

name: program_blitter_from_record
description: Calls a helper, then writes the blitter mask, control and pointer registers from a record, setting the first and last word masks and the modulo words from its fields.

name: wait_while_dma_status_busy
description: Returns at once if a global DMA status bit is clear, otherwise spins until that bit clears.

name: set_color_register_groups
description: Writes zero and three argument values into four consecutive colour registers, then repeats the group for five passes, advancing four registers each time.

name: reset_pending_list_with_count
description: Calls a helper for each linked record until a link is null, then clears the list head, sets a counter to 24 and points a list-pointer global at a fixed address. It returns zero.

name: reset_pending_list_with_count
description: Same reset as its neighbour, looping on the first word of the list head rather than on the next link.

name: copy_record_into_ring_slot
description: Advances a ring index by four, wrapping after twenty-three, then copies a template record of thirty-four words from the argument into the slot that index selects and writes a zero terminator after it.

name: expand_pointer_table_entries
description: Walks 400 entries of a pointer table. For each entry with a size word below a limit it re-bases the entry into a fixed buffer, ORs groups of source words into the destination, adjusts the entry's position fields by a stored offset and sets a delay word from a table.

name: toggle_top_two_bits
description: Toggles bits 14 and 15 of a 16-bit global word.

name: setup_table_pointers_and_flag
description: Calls a helper to get a table result, stores a derived pointer and byte pair from a table, writes a pointer for each offset in a list until a minus one terminator, zeroes four global words and several counters, sets a counter to six and sets a status flag to one.

name: advance_channel_volume_step
description: When a status flag is set, advances a step counter and, at its limit, resets it, recomputes a table offset, calls four helpers, waits for a fixed 256-count loop and writes a status value. Otherwise it calls helpers for each nonzero channel byte. When the table end is reached it clears the flag.

name: clear_playback_state
description: Clears a status flag and zeroes four global words.

name: update_channel_volume_by_type
description: When a counter is nonzero it calls one of two helpers depending on a nibble. It then reads the low nibble of the channel's type byte. Some types lower a volume word by a step with a floor at 113, others raise it by a step with a ceiling at 856, type 13 adjusts a second word by a nibble of its parameter, and types one to five look up a value in a global table. The result is written to the channel's output word.

name: adjust_level_clamped_sixty_four
description: Adds its argument to an internal level word, clamps it to a ceiling of sixty-four and writes the result to the output word.

name: reduce_level_floored_at_zero
description: Subtracts a masked argument from an internal level word, floors it at zero and writes the result to the output word.

name: advance_index_and_end_pass
description: Advances a byte index by sixteen, wrapping at 1024 and counting completed passes. When the pass count reaches its limit and a loop flag is clear, it clears the status flag and zeroes four global words.

name: process_channel_track_command
description: Loads a long word from an input table into a track record. When the high nibble of its control byte is nonzero it loads a pointer pair and offset from a table and updates position and length fields. It then stores status and volume values and handles command nibbles: fourteen copies a word, fifteen sets an enable flag from the parameter nibble, and twelve stores a parameter byte.

name: open_intuition_then_loop
description: When a status byte equals the character code for nine with its top bit clear, it calls the exec library routine that opens the intuition library, then calls one more library function in an endless loop.

name: return_stack_argument_with_global
description: Returns its stack argument together with a global byte placed above it, and does no other work.

name: select_table_entry_pointers
description: Calls two helpers, then when the index argument is not twelve loads a buffer pointer and three long words from a table indexed by the argument.

name: stub_empty_return
description: Returns immediately without doing anything, so it is an empty routine.

name: store_argument_in_global
description: Stores its 16-bit argument in a global word and returns.

name: stub_undecompiled_single_instruction
description: No pseudo-code could be produced. The listed facts show one instruction, called from one routine, so the behaviour is not recovered from this evidence.

name: clear_buffer_after_call
description: Calls one routine, clears a word at an offset from the second address register, then zeroes eight thousand long words of the fixed buffer.

name: run_audio_frame_loop
description: Loops calling a helper and updating global audio output words from four status flags, until a stop word becomes nonzero. It touches the four audio location and length registers and the DMA control register.

name: stub_empty_return
description: Returns immediately, a single instruction with no work.

description: Returns immediately, a single instruction with no work.

name: stub_empty_return
description: Returns immediately, a single instruction with no work.

name: stub_bad_instruction_data
description: Contains only an invalid instruction, so the decompiler truncates control flow here. It is bad data, not a working routine.

name: copy_sixteen_longs_then_call
description: When its pointer argument is not null, copies sixteen long words from a fixed block into it, then calls the routine pointer held in the address register.

name: find_max_and_prepare_buffer
description: Walks a linked list to find the largest value stored at an index field. A library call then decides whether to fill a buffer with an increasing sequence of words and copy a sixteen-long block into the structure. It returns zero on success and minus one when a library call fails.

name: copy_sixteen_longs_then_call
description: When its pointer argument is not null, copies sixteen long words from a fixed block into it, then calls the routine pointer held in the address register.

name: find_max_and_prepare_buffer
description: Same logic as the install variant: walks a linked list for the largest value at an index field, fills a buffer and copies a sixteen-long block when a library call succeeds, and returns zero or minus one.
